interface.longDescription: Start with /baseloop-gtm to design, build, review, and diagnose automated GTM data workflows in Baseloop. The root skill chooses the right workflow and transport: MCP works today, and CLI is used automatically when installed with a healthy tool bridge. Skills install natively via Codex; the companion Bun converter installs the read-only audit agents that Codex's native plugin spec doesn't yet register.
